# Decision 1: Manually convene the Hesperian Council / launch the Fourth Odyssey (incl. after earlier decline).
oe_ely_dec_launch_odyssey = {
	decision_category = oe_cat_colonial_maritime
	only_once = yes
	only_once_scope = country
	potential = {
		NOT = { oe_ely_rule_is_off = yes }
		oe_ely_eligible_tag = yes
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_settled }
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_odyssey_launched }
		NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ely_aborted }
		OR = {
			oe_ely_immediate_1337_ready = yes
			oe_ely_old_world_crisis = yes
			has_variable = oe_ely_declined
		}
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_ely_human_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_ely_launch_eligible_tt
			oe_ely_can_launch_manual = yes
		}
		is_subject = no
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = {
		event_illustration_poptype_effect = {
			foreground = pop_type:nobles
			background = pop_type:burghers
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_ely_dec_launch_odyssey.a
		effect = {
			oe_ely_init_voyage = yes
			if = {
				limit = { oe_ely_rule_is_immediate_1337 = yes }
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_2_done value = 1 }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = oe_ely_ev_1_done value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}
